method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation of the Duties Act 2008 (No. 11 of 2008), mrdoc 49812 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49812.txt; no compilation number or date stated; compilation table runs to the Help to Buy (Commonwealth Powers) Act 2025 Pt. 4 Div. 1 (19 Dec 2025). Rates and thresholds are in the Act itself (Schedule 2, s 142(1)(b), s 266L); no regulation used. The s 236(2)(b) formula for R and the s 266L formulas for X, Y, Z, A and B are missing from the .txt deposit.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the buyer of a home, a car or shares, for the WA lives (Chloe c051, c074, c081, c094; Daniel d037, d055, d065, d071; Jake k074): s 15 (shares not dutiable property); s 20 and Schedule 1 (who pays); ss 23, 25 (lodging within 2 months, $5,000 fine; when to pay); s 26 and Schedule 2 Division 1 (general rate, as a table); s 27 (dutiable value: greater of consideration and unencumbered value); Chapter 2 Part 6 Division 3, ss 141, 142A, 142(1), 143(1), 144 with Schedule 2 Division 2 (first home owner concession, as a table; FHOG eligibility, 'home' and region are facts); Chapter 3, ss 155(2), 161, 163, 184, 186, 188 (landholder duty, $2,000,000 threshold; no s 189); Chapter 3A Part 2, ss 205A, 205H, 205K, 205L, 205M, 205O (foreign transfer duty, 7%); Chapter 6A, ss 266E-266I, 266K, 266L, 266O (off-the-plan concession, closed 30 June 2026; middle-band formula percentage an input); Chapter 5, ss 229, 230, 232, 236, 238 (vehicle licence duty; R an input).
seat: the buyer (of a home, a car or shares)
